# Fixtures for `mp3` (MP3)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The audio is a
synthetic sine tone; titles, names and labels (Saltmere Brass Band, Mira Castell, Ana
Lighthouse, Example Records) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/audio.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `bare-frames-ffmpeg.mp3` | ffmpeg 7.1 (libmp3lame), no tags and no Xing header | CC0-1.0 |
| `bells-lame-cbr.mp3` | LAME 3.100, CBR, ID3v1.1 + ID3v2.3 with cover art | CC0-1.0 |
| `gulls-lame-vbr.mp3` | LAME 3.100, VBR (Xing + LAME tag), ID3v2 only | CC0-1.0 |
| `tour-chapters-ffmpeg.mp3` | ffmpeg 7.1 (libmp3lame), ID3v2.4 with CHAP / CTOC chapters | CC0-1.0 |
